formats.name: input script
formats.lineage_rule: Hash the root and every literal include; variable, shell, Python, geturl, plugin and dynamic control surfaces require explicit code review and authorization.

formats.name: data file
formats.lineage_rule: Bind header counts, box, atom style, topology sections, coefficients, units and type map to the input/model closure.

formats.name: binary restart
formats.lineage_rule: Bind producing executable/build/platform, parent step, external files and commands not stored; never claim archival portability or universal exactness.

formats.name: custom text dump
formats.lineage_rule: Record exact columns, coordinate variant, image flags, box variant, boundary flags, units, sort policy and segment times.

formats.name: native/binary dump
formats.lineage_rule: Require a pinned reader and captured field/layout evidence.

formats.name: DCD/XTC/XYZ/CFG and package dump styles
formats.lineage_rule: The dump style, not extension alone, defines available fields and semantics; verify compiled style availability.

formats.name: log
formats.lineage_rule: Require exact release banner, intended thermo tables, final step/Loop time semantics and no adverse marker; screen and log may differ by launch options.

formats.name: potential/model file
formats.lineage_rule: Hash every artifact and record style, element/type order, UNITS metadata when present, license, cutoff/domain and provider version.

fail_closed_rules: The selected units command controls input, coefficient and output meanings; never relabel values silently.
A restart does not store all fixes, computes, variables, regions, neighbor/KSpace, output commands or every external coefficient/model dependency.
Unknown dump columns or triclinic/general-box variants need an exact parser; do not infer unwrapping.
Treat the input script as code and refuse unreviewed executable/network extension surfaces.
